red_tests.failure_fingerprint: AssertionError: These call sites run a subprocess with a shared, world-writable working directory ... subprocess cwd='/tmp'

rationale: KAN-131 hardening after cross-functional review: the shared /tmp CWD is removed entirely (tempfile.TemporaryDirectory) so the class of bug cannot recur and the fix works on Python 3.10 where -P does not exist; PYTHONSAFEPATH is set in the child env because the -P flag does not propagate to nested interpreters. Guard rewritten to assert the invariant (no shared dir as a subprocess CWD) rather than policing one directory. RED proven by planting a violating call site, which the guard reported as file:line. allowed_source_paths additionally covers rust_core/tests/test_installed_wheel.py, the second real exposure site; that path is classified SOURCE by TEST_PREFIXES so it is committed separately as a source-only change, without a new manifest, as the governance contract requires.
